name: querylens-node
description: QueryLens SDK for Node.js: monitors the queries your app sends to PostgreSQL (pg, postgres.js, Neon), MySQL (mysql2, PlanetScale), SQLite (better-sqlite3, sqlite3, node:sqlite, libSQL / Turso) and MongoDB (mongodb, Mongoose), through Sequelize, Knex, TypeORM, Drizzle, Prisma, Mongoose or the drivers, in production, with values removed, and reports N+1s, loops, slow and failing statements to your QueryLens backend, with fixes for your ORM.
